_comment: Passage of lines (triplex acies): a fresh player reserve line stands behind a thinned player front line already fighting an enemy line. The player box-selects the three fresh units, presses X to switch the group-order mode to Distributed, then right-clicks the CENTER tired unit. Distributed relief pairs each fresh unit with its own nearby engaged tired unit -- the tired units nearest the CLICKED one are relieved, and each fresh unit takes the tired unit in front of it, paired flank to flank along the line so no two pairings cross -- instead of every reliever piling onto the single fight clicked. All three tired units get a real retreat order and all three fresh units close on their own partner's fight by the end of the clip. SELECTION AND CLICK ARE LOAD-BEARING: a box selects a unit whose men (grown by a body radius), regiment point, block centre or raised standard falls inside it, and each tired unit's standard is drawn above its block, over the fresh line's ground, so the old box [520,320]..[1120,420] also took in all three tired units (the HUD read six selected) and the right-click becomes a plain ground MOVE for six units. The box [520,372]..[1120,422] takes only the fresh units' middle and front ranks (y 370-406, the box grown by a body radius to 367.5-426.5) and stops short of the tired units' rear ranks (y 434 on). The click lands on the centre tired unit at y 470 rather than in the seam above the enemy front, where on some seeds it resolved to an ATTACK on the enemy. The expects pin the outcome: all three fresh units carry a RELIEF order at ticks 145 and 215, and all three tired units a MOVE. They also pin the pairing through the foe each fresh unit inherits from its partner: the left fresh unit (uid0) fights the left enemy (uid6), the centre (uid1) the centre (uid7) and the right (uid2) the right (uid8). The two tired units flanking the clicked one stand at the same distance from it, so a pairing by distance alone broke that tie on float noise and paired differently on different seeds.
